pattern.description: Fixed green stem 'Put AI Agents to work for' stays put while the white category word flips: 'Development' pushes up and out with vertical motion blur and 'People' rises in from below and settles.
pattern.why_premium: One sentence carries several audiences through a fast, beat-timed vertical flip; the shorter incoming word leaves the line left-aligned with no reflow of the stem.

build_hint.gsap: Masked line: tl.to('.word-out', {yPercent: -100, opacity: 0, filter: 'blur(6px)', duration: 0.12, ease: 'power2.in'}).fromTo('.word-in', {yPercent: 100, opacity: 0, filter: 'blur(6px)'}, {yPercent: 0, opacity: 1, filter: 'blur(0px)', duration: 0.18, ease: 'power3.out'}, '<0.03'); one swap per music beat.
build_hint.remotion: Inside an overflow-hidden span: out word translateY = interpolate(f, [0, 3], [0, -100])% with blur; in word progress = spring({frame: f - 1, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 300}}), translateY = interpolate(progress, [0, 1], [100, 0])%, blur = interpolate(progress, [0, 1], [6, 0])px.

notes: Same category-cycle mechanic as e031. b01 (diff) spans the old word's footprint, used for the outgoing 'Development'; b02 OCR text reads 'or People', annotated as 'People'. input_text_cycle is the closest id although it is a headline, not an input field.
